name: game-tests
summary: Scripted tests that run inside the real game and press the real keys, mouse and touch: written as a list of steps and named checks, run unattended with no renderer, with a verdict that only this run's log can give.

MODULE.description: The C++ game module the two source files join (the directory under Source/).

MODULE_API.description: That module's export macro, for example MYGAME_API.

adapt: Add "EnhancedInput" to PublicDependencyModuleNames in Source/<Module>/<Module>.Build.cs (Slate and SlateCore are already there for ready-gate).
Close the editor, then compile: node Tools/gam3/ue_build.mjs
Write one class derived from UGam3GameTest per behaviour, in the game module. Start with the bug found most recently by hand.
Prove each new test once against the code before its fix: node Tools/gam3/ue_test.mjs --tests <Name> --expect-fail
Menu and other UI tests need a window: run those with --profile agent.
verify: node Tools/gam3/ue_test.mjs --tests all   (the summary line must start GAM3TEST: ok)

verified.how: Compiled into a C++ test project with ready-gate, in a copy-on-write copy of it made by local-envs. Blind profile: a test that holds W for a second and checks the pawn moved passed; the same test with the check inverted failed by name with exit status 1; --expect-fail turned those into FAILED and ok; a WaitUntil that never comes true failed by name after its 1 s and ended that test; the next test saw W released and the pawn standing still; an unknown test name and a test with no checks both failed, and --expect-fail did not accept them as the expected failure; a run stopped by a 6 s --timeout was reported FAILED no_verdict=1; --tests all ran the seven test classes then present in one start. --shots-on-fail from a blind run re-ran the two failing tests at the agent profile and wrote one picture each. Agent profile (a window): keys, a mouse button after one capturing click, a touch at the right pixel, and an injected Enhanced Input action all reached the player controller, and a key and a click sent without the test's flag were swallowed while the test's own key passed. In the blind profile the first version sent events through Slate and none arrived; events now go to the viewport client there. Not run: any Slate or UMG menu, a real mouse or keyboard moving during a run, hover from a resting cursor, gamepad keys, more than one finger, a test that changes level, PIE, a packaged build, Windows and Linux. The pictures showed this project's featureless default view, so whether a picture includes UI was not seen.
